title: The face from the photo

greeting.text: The bell. Someone your height, your build, in a Corrigan's shirt that still has the fold lines in it.
You know the face. It is squinting into the sun on the noticeboard, under a pin, turned to the wall.
Hello. I'm Sam. I work nights here. I think I'm late.

annoyed: You keep looking at me like I'm a mirror.

notes.wrist: It holds out a staff card with your name on it. Look at the wrists.
notes.reflection: You, Wren, the counter. Look for whoever is standing in front of it.
notes.shadow: New work shoes. Clean floor. Look between them.

topics.ask: Where did you get that face?
topics.answer: From the poster in the window of the ranger station. MISSING. It's a good face. I didn't know it was taken.
Are you? Then we got it from the same place.
The ones we're both wearing. Ask Wren. Wren carried them.

wren.adviceLine: Get it out. Get it out, get it out. It doesn't get to be you. Only you get to be you.

after.serve: You let it stay. With your face on. Sam, what is wrong with you tonight?
after.turnAway: Thank you. Thank you. There's only one of you. I'd know.
after.break: ...You were always the better one. I want you to know that.

serve.text: Thank you. I'll take the pumps. You look tired.
It goes out and stands under the canopy in your shirt, waiting for a shift.

turnAway.text: Yes. I can see that. You wear it better.

break.text: There's room for two of us. There was room for two of you.
It leaves the name tag on the counter. It is the same as yours, down to the scratch.
